info.title: Buy Me a Coffee Universal API
info.description: Read your Buy Me a Coffee memberships, supporters, and extras purchases using a personal access token.

get.description: Retrieves an extra purchase from Buy Me a Coffee by purchase ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the extra purchase returned by the list extras purchases action.

schema.description: The unique ID of the extra purchase returned by the list extras purchases action.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
